svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 02/12 The Citrus Rows (Rare)
svg.desc: Row after row of citrus trees, sweet to sour, kept on campus like a living library. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
